title: The refitted traffic head in round 33's learned net2 and round 29's rules, once on the test links
description: The one test-link run of the traffic head on net1 v7. What was searched on validation, at campaign seed 21: the head's training data (fitted beside the fixed rule, exp-traffic-head-v7-300, it misled the net2s it steered beside a Cubic flow that started first, exp-traffic-head-cubic-first-305; refitted on data from the policies that read it, exp-traffic-head-v7-agg-306, it passed, exp-traffic-head-agg-val-307), and the thresholds at which net2 sharpens its belief in a stock flow (t) and in copies (tq), a 3 by 3 grid over {0.3, 0.5, 0.7} (exp-traffic-head-threshold-val-308): for net2-r33hn, (0.7, 0.3) scored +0.306 on the stated score (half the five-family mean plus half the copies score, over three seeds) against +0.261 at (0.5, 0.5), every seed ahead, so it replaced it; for net2-v7hpn the best pair, (0.7, 0.5), beat (0.5, 0.5) by 0.017, under the stated 0.02, so it kept (0.5, 0.5). Round 33's iteration (59) was chosen on validation by its gain beside a Cubic flow that started first, before the refit (exp-traffic-r33-val-303), and not searched again. Arms: net2-r33hn, round 33's learned net2 reading the refitted head and taking its belief in copies from it (t 0.7, tq 0.3); net2-v7hpn, round 29's net2 with both beliefs from the head, whose actor is then unused, so it is the gate3 rules switched by net1's head (t 0.5, tq 0.5); round 29's learned net2 on its own beliefs (net2-v7, t 0.5, tested in exp-dagger7-test-280), all three training seeds each; reference line: the fixed rule at u = 0.25 (rule-v7). The five families (training seed 13, others 31), the held-out competitors (BBRv3 and Westwood) and 2 and 4 copies. Reading, stated before the results: the head counts as carrying over to the test links if net2-r33hn gains at least 0.05 over net2-v7 among copies and loses no more than 0.02 on the five-family mean, both over three seeds. Nothing is chosen or tuned on these links.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); G="$IN/n/traffic_head.pt"; echo "8ad397a52a7f09fc2b2a136f017d0a52b49a5f0bfcae9f10040d8a015891f2e8  $G" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hpn-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --tq 0.5 --traffic "$G" --traffic-p; r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s$s"; e="$OUT/runs/r33-s$s"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter059/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; cp "$G" "$e/traffic_head.pt"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-r33hn-s$s" "$e" --t 0.7 --tq 0.3 --traffic "$G"; for a in v7 v7hpn r33hn; do P+=(--policy "net2-$a-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-$a-s$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 20 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s
